messages.主力のS2「炎手撃-燃」で火傷回数を積み、火傷を周囲の敵へ広げる火傷パーティの回: A Burn team's Count supplier that mainly uses S2 Fiery Knifehand-Combust to add Burn Count and spread Burn to nearby enemies. Allies build Potency, then she finishes a fully stacked target with S3 Pinpoint Blitz's Wrath damage.
messages.S2「炎手撃-燃」(主力): 3コイン。Ⅰ・Ⅱコインの的中時と、Ⅲコインの表面的: **S2 Fiery Knifehand-Combust (main skill)**: 3 Coins. +1 Burn Count on Coin Ⅰ and Ⅱ hits and on Coin Ⅲ Heads Hit. On Coin Ⅲ hit, if the target has at least 6 Burn Count, inflicts 3 Burn on the 2 enemies with no Burn or the lowest Burn Count. +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Burn (+1 per 6 Burn, up to 2, at higher Uptie).
messages.S3「一点突破」: 4コイン。Ⅰ〜Ⅲコインで火傷1・1・2を付与し、Ⅳコインで対: **S3 — Pinpoint Blitz**: 4 Coins. Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ inflict 1, 1, and 2 Burn, and Coin Ⅳ deals Wrath damage equal to half of the target's Burn Potency (all of it at higher Uptie), up to 20/30, and reduces Burn Count by 2. +30% damage if the target's Burn and Burn Count are both 6 or more.
messages.バトルパッシブ「アツい勢い」(憤怒×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 対象の火傷威力: **Combat passive — Burning Passion (3 Wrath Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +5/10% damage per 6 Burn Potency on the target, up to 15/30%. At Combat Start, if all enemies have at least 6 Burn, gives 1 Wrath DMG Up to allies in team order (up to the number of Wrath Absolute Resonance), plus 1 Attack Power Up if the target is a Liu Association Fixer.
messages.S1「炎拳撃」: Ⅰ・Ⅱコインで火傷1ずつ。対象の火傷が3以上でコイン威力+1(: **S1 — Flaming Fists**: Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ inflict 1 Burn each. +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 3 Burn (+1 per 3 Burn, up to 2, at higher Uptie).
messages.サポートパッシブ「アツアツの激励」(憤怒×6・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 精神力が: **Support passive — Passionate Cheer (6 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When the 1 ally with the lowest SP lands an attack, +5% Pierce damage per 6 Burn Potency on the target, up to 15%.
messages.自分で付与できる火傷威力はS1・S3の1〜2ずつと少ないので、火傷威力を付与する: She can only inflict 1–2 Burn Potency at a time with S1 and S3, so pair her with other Burn Identities who inflict Burn Potency while she covers Burn Count with S2. Fighting around S2 is the basic approach. Once the target's Burn Count reaches 6 or more, spread 3 Burn to surrounding enemies with S2's Coin Ⅲ. S3 has a damage cap (20/30) and also reduces Burn Count by 2, so firing it before Burn Potency has built up tends to be a loss. Fire it once Burn and Burn Count are both 6 or more. Burning Passion's ally buffs are determined by team order, so place the Wrath allies you want to buff at the front.
